topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; POL-01 sanctions statement approved 2026-09-04; not yet applied to a security case
gap: Sanctions not yet exercised or communicated

control_description: Majority owner and board of managers receive a security update twice a year; CIP self-report briefed 2026-09-04
remediation: Quarterly security and CIP compliance report to the board

control_description: Information Security Lead, CIP Senior Manager, and delegate designated in writing; reporting lines in POL-01
evidence: CIP Senior Manager record; delegation record; POL-01

control_description: Background checks at hire; annual CIP awareness module for all staff; no OT role-based security training
remediation: OT module for DCC and protection staff (POAM-019)

control_description: Policies assign owners; POA&M items have owners and dates
gap: Accountability not yet tested through a review cycle

control_description: Risk register and SSP exist; OT inventory incomplete; OT logs not collected
gap: Incomplete OT inventory and no OT log data

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved 2026-09-04; acknowledgments pending; CIP awareness delivered 2026-03
gap: Policies not yet acknowledged by staff

control_description: Operating agreements with the transmission owner; customer outage communications; vendor contracts lack security terms
gap: No security terms or contacts with key vendors

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives and risk tolerance set in POL-01 and P01
2026 risk assessment per SP 800-30 covering IT and OT (P01)
Fraud risk partly covered (business email compromise R-027); no review of CIS refund or meter-tampering fraud
remediation: Add CIS refund, payment, and meter-tampering fraud to the 2027 risk assessment

control_description: CIP-002 change triggers in POL-01 4.6; Substation E went live in 2025 without a security review
gap: Significant OT changes are not security-reviewed (Substation E access list)
remediation: Security check in the substation commissioning and change procedure (POAM-013)

control_description: First independent assessment 2026-08 (P07); no ongoing monitoring
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners; CIP noncompliance self-reported to SERC

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP against a tailored High baseline; many planned
General IT controls strong on the corporate side (EDR, MFA); weak in OT

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies approved; OT procedures (accounts, jump host, kiosk) not yet written

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO and MFA for IT and SaaS; OT uses shared accounts and no MFA on the jump host
gap: Shared OT accounts and no OT MFA

control_description: IT accounts from HR tickets; OT accounts on manager email; vendor account shared
Role-based access in SCADA and OMS; OT accounts never reviewed; transfers not handled
DCC badge access; substations locked and alarmed; control house keys untracked
gap: Untracked keys; 3 held by former staff

control_description: Certified destruction of drives; retired relays and HMIs not listed in the destruction log
remediation: Add OT devices to the disposal procedure

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Corporate perimeter firewall with IDS; vendor remote access standing and shared; VPN without MFA
gap: Remote access paths into OT are weak

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for SaaS and OMS; DNP3 unauthenticated over radio and cellular; relay passwords in a readable spreadsheet
gap: Unprotected field protocols; exposed relay passwords
remediation: Password vault (POAM-020); DNP3 protection study (P01 R-024)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on corporate endpoints; antivirus on SCADA with manual updates; contractor laptops and USB media unchecked

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Corporate vulnerability scanning monthly; no OT vulnerability monitoring; incomplete OT inventory

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: Corporate EDR alerts to IT; no OT monitoring or log review
POL-03 and P08 define triage and the Reportable determination; not yet exercised
P08 OT runbook approved 2026-09-04; low impact plan test overdue
Manual operation procedures exist; SCADA recovery untested; backups not isolated
evidence: Storm restoration plan; P07 CP-4 and CP-9

control_description: Corporate change board for IT; no change control for relay settings, gateway access lists, or SCADA displays
BIA done (P05); storm restoration plan exercised yearly; no cyber recovery procedure
gap: No cyber recovery procedure for SCADA

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: CIS vendor SOC 2 on file; AMI vendor SOC 2 reviewed 2026-08 (Part B); no security terms for SCADA, OMS, or AMI vendors
